title: Email Forward — Forensic Triage and External Reporting

fields.subject: FW: Forensic Triage — EHR Database Encryption and Data Exfiltration
fields.note: The managed detection service has completed initial forensic triage. We confirm the ransomware encrypted the CareLine EHR database and the file shares on ORRMC-FS01. The on-site backup repository on ORRMC-BKP01 was deleted. The immutable cloud copy of the EHR database remains unaltered in the vault. The attacker's note claims data was copied prior to encryption and demands payment within 72 hours. We advise engaging outside counsel and a forensic firm under legal privilege. Report to the FBI Cleveland Field Office, CISA, H-ISAC, and the cyber insurer immediately. The Liaison Officer must notify the Lucas County EMA and the Ohio Department of Health. The ransom decision is not made today — Section 7 of the CIRP applies.
fields.signature:
Marcus Hale
Information Security Officer
Ottawa River Regional Medical Center

original.subject: Critical Alert: Ransomware Attack on EHR Database and File Shares
original.body: Forensic triage so far: the ransomware encrypted the CareLine EHR database and the file shares on ORRMC-FS01. The on-site backup repository on ORRMC-BKP01 was deleted at 05:12. We cannot yet confirm whether the immutable cloud copy of the EHR database was reached; the cloud console shows no deletion. The attacker's note on ORRMC-SQL01 demands payment within 72 hours and states data was copied. We advise you to engage outside counsel and a forensic firm today and to report to the FBI and CISA. Do not engage the attacker. The EHR database remains encrypted, and the interface engine is down. Recommend isolating all EHR-dependent systems and disabling the compromised svc-ehr-admin account.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the external reporting and legal engagement phase. Watch for the AOC to initiate the Policy Group meeting and for the ISO to call the FBI and CISA. The ransom decision point is not to be made here.
